ai_summary: AGI Infra Limited reported strong financial performance for Q1 2026, demonstrating significant year-over-year and quarter-over-quarter growth in total income, EBITDA, and Profit After Tax, reflecting healthy operational margins. While the company maintains a robust project pipeline and land reserves primarily focused on premium housing in Punjab, a material concern is the substantial unsold inventory across ongoing projects (~54%) and entirely unsold upcoming projects, coupled with long completion timelines extending to 2032, which could pose future market and liquidity risks given the regional concentration.
